title: RestDay

videos.title: How to make a MUG cake

textBlocks:
Rule Number 4
The Lord told Moses
that His people must REST
They must only work for SIX days of the week
Do you guys know the days of the week?

Now Moses had been UP on the MOUNTAIN for 40 days!
Getting All these instructions.

And then the Lord did something amazing
HE WROTE ON THE 2 STONE TABLETS
- THE 10 COMMANDMENTS -

CAKE TIME
Now today we going to bake a MUG CAKE
But for it to work - we must follow instructions
Ask you mom or dad to help you

PRAYER TIME
Dear Lord Jesus 
Thank you for giving us rules to keep us safe
Thank you for giving us a day to rest
A day to enjoy you dear Lord
Amen
